# SetupProgress

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Setup` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Setup/SetupRunner.cs#L92)

What a sequence has done so far: one status, note and duration per step, plus how it ended.

Kept as one JSON blob in [`SessionState`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/SessionState.html) rather than in a static field,
because the whole point of the runner is that it survives the script reloads the setup
causes, and a window watching it has to survive them too. It outlives the run itself -
only starting another sequence clears it - so the window can still show what happened
after the last step has finished.

Treat it as read-only; [`SetupRunner`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-setup/SetupRunner) owns the writing.
